name: OSS_EVENT_TRANSACTIONS
description: When the corresponding profile option is enabled to log the changes made on tables like subscription, products and associations, and based on the configurations done on OSS_CHANGE_LOG_CONFIG, whenever an action is performed, that is performed under a single transaction. This table stores the main details of such a transaction to identify from where, what action was performed and which record is affected on a higher level.

columns.name: EVENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier of the transaction event details.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Local transaction id to group the action changes for different entities together.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: The action to which this logging is done for. Example: Activate, UpdateAttribute, Amend, Renew etc.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The object to which this logging is done for. Example: Subscription, Product and ProductAssociation.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: To identify the exact object to which the logging is done for.

columns.name: OBJECT_PUID
columns.description: PUID to uniquely identify the object from its corresponding table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
